definitions.short case: printed 3Q26 nights <= 8.5% (latent < 8.55) OR C02 = (d) OR C04 = (d); literal reading per the A19 brief
definitions.base: print < 10.6% AND (C02 in {b, c} OR C01 = Yes) AND not short case
definitions.none of the above: everything else (accelerating print with a non-(a) descriptor and no short gate 0.065; flat/decel print with C02 (a) or (e) and guide at/above 0.018)
definitions.precedence: thesis breaker > short case > base > none; breaker-and-short overlap (C04 (d) on a breaker print) 0.033 goes to the breaker

alternative_material_reading.definition: short-case C02 leg = explicit mid-single-or-lower bucket only (0.39 of C02's (d), its published sub-split), not the directional 'moderate' sentence
alternative_material_reading.note: the memo must state which reading it quotes; the QUESTIONS.md text says 'bucket', the brief says option (d)

final.note: pending-decision structure (every gate is a 5 Nov disclosure); the short case is the modal cell under the literal definition both in the joint and in the reaction panel (W2 0.50); no option below 0.09

scenario_table.columns: P; day-1 return from the S01 rev-2 cells (median %, P(<= -8%), P(>= +5%)); 15 Dec close from the S02 rev-2 branches rescaled to S02's final median (conditional median USD, p25-p75, P(<=150), P(>=180)); E[nights]; P(C01 below)
scenario_table.read: base and short case carry the same day-1 and 15 Dec distributions: S01 prices the print state and the guide-vs-Street sign, not the descriptor wording or the margin sentence, and the panel shows no steeper day-1 on deeper decelerations; the memo's $115-130 short-case price is a 12-month fundamental target, not a reaction-function output. The memo's 25/45/30 table should be replaced by this table with a 'none' row.

joint_structure.print: latent 3Q26 nights y/y ~ N(9.5, 1.70) [adopted_print_states_v2.json, R01/R02 rev 2]
joint_structure.c01: gap ~ N(g0 + 0.66 (nights - 9.5), 3.1), g0 = -1.923 solved for P(gap < 0) = 0.72; slope from C01's own guide structure (2/3 weight on 3Q26 GBV); S01's 0.32 is a sensitivity (no option moves)
joint_structure.c02: log-odds piecewise-linear in nights through C02 rev 2's three branch conditionals (anchored at 7.86 / 9.52 / 11.24), per-option factors fitted so the marginal under N(9.5, 1.70) equals C02's final vector; (c or d) block split by C01 at odds ratio 2 (S01)
joint_structure.c04: C04 rev 2's published conditionals on C01 (below / not below); independent of the print given C01
joint_structure.day1: S01 rev 2 twelve-cell tables (state x C01 x C02 c/d), inverse-CDF sampling of the published percentile/threshold points
joint_structure.dec15: S02 rev 2 branch medians (172.3 / 165.5 / 163.0 / 156.1) x 1.0156, within-branch log-sd 0.172
joint_structure.correlations_assumed: C02 depends on the print (its own tree) and on C01 (OR 2); C04 depends on C01 only; the day-1 return depends on the S01 state and C01 and not on C02 wording or C04; no other links

base_rate_detail.source: datasets/x01_base_rate_panel.csv (C_print_panel.csv x C02 descriptor dataset x FY-margin ledger)

estimates.anchor_source: deck/drafts/memo_v2_short_2026-09-16.md scenario table (25/45/30, no 'none' row), 2026-09-16; no market prices this object; the memo's short case is its conjunctive fundamental scenario (mass 0.05 here), not the question's disjunction
estimates.independence_note: final = the joint of six audited marginals; the anchor is the un-audited table they replace. The base rate (W2) and the joint agree on breaker (0.10 vs 0.14) and short (0.50 vs 0.55) and differ on none (0.20 vs 0.08, n 2 of 10); 'none' rounded up to 0.09.
